messages:
marcos: Heads-up — ran a quick comparison between bitsandbytes weight-only (bnb-8bit) and llm.int8 on nova-13b using our chat prompt deck. Seeing a quality spike (repetition / hallucination) for bnb at low temps. Short log below.

devlin: Oof. What config? batchsize? seq_len?

marcos: Ran with:
```
model=nova-13b
quant=bnb-8bit   # bitsandbytes weight-only
batch=8
seq=1024
temp=0.1,0.3,0.8
top_p=0.95
```
latency (mean per-token step): bnb=13.6ms, llm.int8=15.9ms
throughput (tokens/s): bnb=73k, llm.int8=63k

marcos: But quality: on low-temp instruction prompts bnb had ~12% token-repeat failures; llm.int8 only ~2%. Example outputs: 
```
prompt: "Summarize policy X in one sentence."
bnb: "Policy X is a policy that policy that policy X ..."
llm.int8: "Policy X requires users to verify identity before accessing sensitive endpoints."
```

anya: Did you run with per-channel scaling vs symmetric? bnb defaults can be aggressive.

marcos: Used bnb default `--bnb-8bit-weight-only`. We tried enabling `--bnb-quantize-narrow` and it helped slightly. Will rerun with per-channel fallback.

samir: Any difference across eval slices? e.g., short factual vs creative?

marcos: Yes — creative prompts (temp >= 0.8) bnb ~= llm.int8. Deterministic/factual prompts (temp <= 0.3) bnb regresses.

liz: Could be softmax scaling / logits magnitude shrink. Did you compare logits distributions?

marcos: Quick check shows bnb logits stdev smaller by ~0.5 for head positions after ~200 tokens. That correlates with collapse.

ci-bot: junit:quant-check 1912345678 -> completed (diff attached)

marcos: Plan: 1) re-run bnb with per-channel + clip-value tuning 2) do layer-wise ablation to find culprit layers 3) run AWQ/GPTQ baseline on same deck 4) add routing fallback: classify 'factual' prompts -> route to llm.int8.

devlin: For production routing, let's also add a cheap classifier (fast embedding) to pick path. I can prototype.

marcos: Assigning: samir you'll run per-channel bnb runs (2 configs). devlin prototype classifier. liz will collect logits+entropy traces. ETA EOD Thursday.

samir: on it. starting runs now, posting metrics.

liz: I'll add a quick trace endpoint to redwood-console for these runs so we can see token-level entropy.

marcos: Thanks. If anyone sees similar spikes in other models drop a note. Also flag if AWQ shows same behaviour — that will tell whether quant scheme vs weight-only approach is to blame.

qa-bot: added task #INFER-826 to Jira: "8bit pathing: bnb collapse on low-temp factual prompts" assignees: samir, liz, devlin

marcos: sweet. keeping this thread for quick sync. :rocket:
